# Sample Restaurant v0.03

A visual-first, preview-safe restaurant demo with real photo backgrounds, menu tabs, event packages, and a gallery snippet.

## Visual capability
- Remote hero background image
- Image gallery snippet
- Menu tabs: starters, mains, desserts
- Event packages and calendar teaser

## Routes
- / text/html
- /health application/json
- /llms.txt text/plain
- /robots.txt text/plain
- /sitemap.xml application/xml
- /schema.json application/json

## Guardrails
Preview only. No production routes. No custom domains. No account IDs. No secrets.
